title: Summary: Consolidation: Verbal Periphrases and Duration

sections.content:
Verbal periphrases enrich your ability to express aspect and time:
• *Acabar de + inf*: immediate past
• *Llevar + tiempo + gerundio*: ongoing duration
• *Llevar + tiempo + sin + inf*: negative duration
• *Ponerse a + inf*: sudden beginning
• *Al + inf*: simultaneous temporal connection.

items.spanish: Acabo de llegar y ya me puse a trabajar.
items.english: I just arrived and I already started working.

items.spanish: Llevamos dos horas esperando el tren.
items.english: We've been waiting for the train for two hours.

sections.content: Keep gerunds and infinitives distinct: *llevar + gerundio*, but *acabar de + infinitivo* and *sin + infinitivo*.
